Body.Content:
Azure is introducing Cost Management by Cloudyn, a recently acquired service that will help organizations manage and optimize cloud spend across a multi-cloud environment. The service is now available to all Azure customers and partners, and will be fully integrated into Azure over time. Customers and partners will be able to use Azure Cost Management for free to manage their Azure spend until June 30, 2018.

See the Cloudyn product page for more information.
